title: Sora and Hara
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Manabu Hara, a gay teacher at an all-boys school who feels adrift, meets a young man named Sorano at a gay bar and then finds he is a new student at his school. Hara shuts down any relationship, but the situation stirs up his own teenage feelings and lingering ties to a former, now-graduated student, Rihito. A side story in Asumiko Nakamura's Classmates series (English Classmates vol. 4).
life_message: A good life means facing loneliness and aging honestly, and holding a teacher's boundary even when feelings say otherwise.

content.note: Gay adult romance; a student's romantic interest in his teacher, which Hara refuses (Seven Seas blurb via Penguin Random House, AniList); MangaUpdates tags student-teacher relationship and age gap. Non-graphic in summaries.
